player_prompt.intro:
I Kuhn Poker khel {max_rounds} round khelhnaah Player {player_id} i ni.
Khel Dan:
- Kuhn Poker hian J, Q, K (J hniam ber, K sang ber) nei 3-card deck a hmang
- Player tinin {ante} chip an pe a, round tinah card 1 an dawng (card te hi chhut thlak theih lohvin an sem darh a, i khingpui nen card in ang thei lo)
- Khelh hi {max_rounds} round chhung a awh
- Round zawng zawng zawh hnuah chip ngah zawk zawk chuan a chak
Khelh Dan (Action):
- '[check]': Bet awm loh chuan pass (bet loh chuan)
- '[bet]': Pot-ah chip 1 belh (bet awm loh chuan)
- '[call]': Khingpui bet ang khat aia pot-ah chip 1 belh
- '[fold]': I kut kaipui a, khingpuiin pot a la
